acceptanceCriteria: The owner records in `docs/BUILD-LOG.md` either the promotion evidence required for the external-evidence profiles or the decision that they remain experimental, and links the issue #64 disposition.
body:
Filed from the audit of https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/64 (generic ExternalEvidenceProvider contract) on 2026-09-22.

`docs/specs/README.md:18-26` keeps EEP V0/V1/V2, EFO V0 and ETS V0/V1 experimental. Only the in-tree mock provider exists, so the generic-contract questions in issue #64 have no external evidence behind them. Owner decision needed: what independent adopter or interoperability record promotes these profiles, and does the generic contract in issue #64 become a V3 spec or amend V0?
title: extevidence: EEP, ETS and EFO stay experimental pending an independent adopter record
